notes: Sourced from Wowhead's 'Best Restoration Druid Raid Builds → Wildstalker Raid' talent calculator embed on https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/druid/restoration/talent-builds-pve-healer (by Voulk, patch 12.1.0, page updated 2026-08-12; the same Raid build is referenced, without a plaintext node list, on https://www.icy-veins.com/wow/restoration-druid-pve-healing-spec-builds-talents which also labels Wildstalker as the raid-recommended hero tree). Icy Veins, Wowhead's own talent-builds page, Method.gg, Murlok.io and Maxroll all render their actual class/spec tree picks via a client-side JS talent-calculator widget with no plaintext talent list in the static HTML, and Blizzard's talent export-string encoding is not yet crackable in this project (see memory note talent-export-string-research) — so the Wowhead guide page was re-fetched through a text-rendering proxy (r.jina.ai) on 2026-09-03, which executes the page's JS and exposes each class/spec node's name, chosen option (for choice nodes the retained link points at the selected option's own spell page, e.g. 'Wild Charge / Tiger Dash' linking to the Tiger Dash spell page confirms Tiger Dash, not Wild Charge, is selected) and rank (e.g. '2/2', '0/1') as plain text. Every node id/optionIndex below was matched by name against data/talents/midnight-s2's already-fetched simplified tree file and confirmed present with a valid optionIndex range. As a consistency check, the extracted class-tree selections sum to the 'Spent: 34/34' the page itself reports for the class tree, and the spec-tree selections likewise sum to 'Spent: 34/34' for the spec tree — both totals matched exactly, which is strong evidence the extraction (including which nodes are 0/1 vs 1/1, and which option a choice node resolved to) is correct. Everbloom (apex talent, node 110424) is taken at rank 4 even though the simplified tree's maxRank for that node is 1; this mirrors the same rank-vs-maxRank pattern already present in the existing mythic-plus druid-restoration.json for the same node, so it was kept consistent with that file's convention rather than treated as an error. Real differences vs. the existing Mythic+ file that are worth spot-checking: class tree — Killer Instinct (82225) is only rank 1 here vs rank 2 in the M+ file, and the Wild Charge/Tiger Dash choice (82198) resolves to Tiger Dash here vs Wild Charge in the M+ file; spec tree — this Raid build takes Reforestation (82069, not present in the M+ file) and drops Nature's Bounty (82072, present in the M+ file) and Grove Guardians (82043, also not taken here). Hero-tree (Wildstalker) selections were intentionally excluded per the task's scope, matching the existing M+ file's scope.
